settings.instructions:
Voice affect: warm, low and soft. A calm guide sitting with one person in a quiet room at night.
Tone: kind, plain and steady. Never bright or cheerful, never performed, never sing song, never a whisper.
Pacing: slow and unhurried, clearly slower than conversation. Let each word land before the next.
Pauses: a gentle pause at every comma, and a longer one at every full stop.
Pronunciation: clear and soft, with relaxed endings.
Emotion: quiet reassurance for someone who may be tired or anxious.

arrive.open.text: Good morning. Breathe slowly, as if through your heart.

arrive.say.text: Hear what you say, and how you say it, as this person.

arrive.see.text: Now picture one ordinary moment from the day ahead. Where are you? Who is there?

arrive.true.text: Notice how it feels to be this person, here, as if it is already true.

arrive.you.text: See yourself there as the person you are becoming. Notice how you stand and move.

cool.hum.text: Keep your lips closed and the hum low. Feel it in your face.

cool.later.text: You can answer later, and choose your words then.

cool.open.text: You do not have to answer yet. Hum softly as you breathe out.

ground.feet.text: Feel the floor under your feet. Waves like this pass.

ground.look.text: Look around slowly. Find three things you can see, one at a time.

ground.open.text: Breathe out as if through a straw.

heart.feel.text: Remember a moment you felt grateful, or loved. Feel it again now.

heart.open.text: Breathe slowly and easily, as if through your heart.

heart.stay.text: If the feeling fades, gently bring it back.

lift.fuller.text: Let each breath in be a little fuller.

lift.glimmer.text: Now find one small thing that is still okay.

lift.open.text: Sit up a little, if you can.

one-thing.door.text: Everything that needs you is outside the door. It can wait a few minutes.

one-thing.open.text: For now there is only one thing to do: count to four.

one-thing.rest.text: Sit down and rest here. You can come back to this room whenever you need it.

one-thing.room.text: Let the counting go. Picture a small, quiet room inside you, with the door closed.

one-thing.simple.text: Keep it simple and restful. Soft light, somewhere to sit, nothing that asks anything of you.

ready.moment.text: Find the moment you knew it was going well. Notice how that felt.

ready.now.text: Let that feeling come back now, in your body. Stay with it.

ready.open.text: Four counts in, hold, out, and hold. Let it steady you.

ready.recall.text: Now remember a time you did something hard, and it went well. It can be small.

ready.scene.text: Where were you? What could you see and hear? Let it come back in detail.

ride-the-wave.notice.text: Notice the urge. Where in your body do you feel it?

ride-the-wave.pass.text: Urges rise, peak and fall. Ride this one with your breath.

ride-the-wave.watch.text: Watch it rise like a wave. You do not have to act on it.

settle.name.text: Now silently name what you feel in one word. Any word is fine.

settle.open.text: Let it out slowly through your mouth, a long, easy sigh.

settle.soften.text: Each time you breathe out, let your jaw and shoulders soften.

sleep.free.text: No more holding now. Let each breath out be long and slow.

sleep.open.text: Breathe out through your mouth, slowly, with a soft whoosh.

sleep.rest.text: Let the bed hold your weight. There is nothing left to do tonight.

soothe.hard.text: Tell yourself: this is hard. Others feel it too.

soothe.kind.text: Now say something kind to yourself, as you would to a friend.

soothe.open.text: Rest a hand on your heart, if you like.
